name: Leeds
registryBasis: HM Land Registry publishes a Leeds City Council INSPIRE Index Polygons partition; geometry-only extraction verifies a registered-freehold extent polygon at the WUP point. This source provides indicative property extent, not complete parcel or exact legal-boundary coverage.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Three official Leeds registered-freehold index polygons are verified, including one containing the WUP locator. The existing official GML snapshot adapter rejects the published 47,623,426-byte authority ZIP at its hard 24 MiB archive cap; its observed 303,784 members also exceed the hard 150,000-feature cap. No runtime viewport/exact-ID/footprint contract has been qualified for Leeds. Archive-member ordinals identify research samples only. Indicative boundaries, freehold-only scope and source vintage are informational, not eligibility gates.
scopeLimits: The 2026-09-06 Leeds HMLR INSPIRE partition produced three complete polygons within 1 km of the point (one contains it). INSPIRE Index Polygons cover registered freehold property only and are indicative extents, not exact legal boundaries; this does not establish complete citywide parcel coverage.
remainingUncertainty: HMLR index polygons cover registered freeholds only. Exact legal boundary/citywide coverage and suitability for runtime remain unverified.

executedQueries.query: Leeds INSPIRE index polygons HM Land Registry Leeds City Council authority file parcel geometry 2026
executedQueries.scope: Find current city-specific registration/map evidence and safe anonymous geometry routes.
executedQueries.result: The official HMLR portal publishes local-authority INSPIRE Index Polygons, with Leeds City Council as a downloadable partition. The 2026-09-06 file was fetched anonymously. Geometry-only parsing of 303,784 GML features found three complete polygons within 1 km of the exact WUP point: one containing it and two nearest neighbors at 10.433 m and 15.543 m. The official technical specification describes registered freehold extent polygons as indicative and not exact legal boundaries. Only GEOMETRY nodes were read; no feature attribute values were read or joined. Sample identifiers are 1-based GML member ordinals.
executedQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search plus direct inspection of public official/local source routes.
